items.source: In that case, there will be no need to invoke releaseTarget(Object), and the AOP framework can cache the return value of getTarget().

items.source: If a TargetSource is "static", it will always return the same target, allowing optimizations in the AOP framework. Dynamic target sources can support pooling, hot swapping, etc.
items.translation: 如果 `<code>TargetSource` 是“静态”的，它将始终返回同一个目标，从而允许 AOP 框架进行优化。动态目标源可以支持连接池、热替换等功能。
